sledge.desc: Fence post welded to a railroad spike.

pipe_pistol.desc: Hand-rolled barrel. Ugly, but it goes bang.

longhorn.desc: Six heavy arguments. Kicks like a mule.

brannock_longhorn.desc: Hand-fitted action, tuned by Ironhand himself. One of a kind.

rattler.desc: Fully automatic. Hold FIRE and hang on.

hunting_rifle.desc: Bolt action with a scope. Patient work.

street_sweeper.desc: Six shells of pump-action crowd control.

arc_pistol.desc: Cell-fed energy sidearm from before the fall.

arc_rifle.desc: Meridian security issue. Burns a clean hole.

vault_suit.desc: Teal and cream. Standard shelter issue.

road_leathers.desc: Caravan guard gear. Light and tough.

hazmat.desc: Blocks 60% of environmental radiation. Stops very little else.

super_stim.desc: Halloran's recipe. Restores 110 health and glows slightly.

cram.desc: Restores 18 health. Do not read the label.

stew.desc: Restores 38 health. Tastes like somebody cares.

rad_tabs.desc: Take 75% less radiation for three minutes.

moonshine.desc: +30% melee damage for 90 seconds. Tastes like paint.

pipe_bomb.desc: Thrown explosive. Tap NADE to throw. Mind your own feet.

glow_fungus.desc: Grows where the water glows. Halloran wants these.

sample_well.desc: Drawn from the Dustwell well. Faintly green.

sample_glow.desc: It lights up the inside of your pack.

regulator.desc: A sealed Meridian part. It fits a reactor. It also fits the recycler in Haven 12.

tool_roll.desc: Forty years of files and reamers in oiled leather.

trade_ledger.desc: Every debt from here to the coast.

service_pistol.desc: Vault security issue. Reliable, boring, and still in its oil cloth.

lever_rifle.desc: A .44 repeater. Fast follow-up shots, no scope.

carbine.desc: Military surplus. Fully automatic rifle rounds.

marksman.desc: Long barrel, longer reach. One shot, one problem solved.

ion_caster.desc: Meridian riot-control prototype. Sprays a fan of charged particles.

buzzsaw.desc: Six barrels and a bad attitude. Slows you down while carried.

bat.desc: Nails, tape, and an old grudge.

piston_fist.desc: Hydraulic knuckles. Every punch lands like a falling crate.

duster.desc: Long coat with a high collar. +1 Charm.

kevlar.desc: Pre-war police vest. Light and dependable.

riot_gear.desc: Full riot kit with padding. +1 Endurance.

lamp_robes.desc: Hooded engineer robes. 35% radiation resistance, +1 Charm.

sentinel_plate.desc: Salvaged security armour. Enormous protection. -1 Agility, +1 Might.

ox_steak.desc: Restores 32 health. Dust Ox, seared over a barrel fire.

boar_hide.desc: Thick and bristly. Hollis Grange wants these.

logic_core.desc: The brain of a security drone. Wick pays well for these.

governor_chip.desc: A little board soldered into Old Patsy. It decides who wins. Nobody, mostly.

spur_chip.desc: A heavy silver casino chip. Any vendor takes it at face value.

buggy_key.desc: A bent key on a rabbit-foot ring. Starts the buggy parked behind Brannock's.

fuel_can.desc: Half a can of cut gasoline. Useful for engines and bad ideas.

medal.desc: Struck by the Finch caravan line for people who save their wagons.

lucky_sour.desc: Della's cactus-lime sour. +2 Luck for four minutes. Feels like the dice are listening.

prickly_pop.desc: Pink, fizzy, alarming. Action points recover 60% faster for two minutes.

vip_marker.desc: A heavy gold chip with your name scratched into it. High-roller chips and table limits at the Silver Spur.

snub_pistol.desc: Small enough to hide in a boot, loud enough to regret it.

tokar_pistol.desc: An officer's pistol from a war nobody remembers winning.

steppe_rifle.desc: Buried in mud, dug up, fired. It never cared either way.

frontier_br.desc: Semi-automatic, full-power rounds. Kicks like an ox and hits like one too.

ripper_smg.desc: Empties a magazine in two seconds flat. Bring a lot of magazines.

homestead.desc: Every farmhouse in the valley had one. Most still do.

longshot.desc: Bolt-action with real glass on top. One breath, one shot.

iron_crown.desc: A circlet of welded rebar and bolt heads. Ironside's raiders follow whoever wears it.

chapel_bell.desc: You rigged the bell for hauling. Saltreach's salt guards will drag it home once you tell Brother Amos.

fuel_injector.desc: A brass-and-steel injector from a cargo plane engine. Jun Takeda has been dreaming about this.

black_box.desc: An orange box, scorched but intact. Wick can read it at Relay 4.

abara_tags.desc: Two steel tags on a chain: ABARA, RUTH. KESTREL RELIEF WING.

powder_crate.desc: A sealed crate of quarry blasting powder. Do not drop it. Do not sit on it.

sea_postcard.desc: A faded card: blue water to the edge of the world. GREETINGS FROM CORAL BAY.

sealed_parcel.desc: A wax-sealed bundle from Cass for Oskar Vane. It sloshes, faintly.
sealed_parcel.openMsg: You break the wax. Inside: pages torn from Saltreach's town ledger, and a lot of numbers about water.

ledger_pages.desc: Pages torn out of Saltreach's town ledger. Someone was skimming water.

seed_pack.desc: Bean, squash, tomato and maize. Real seeds that could grow under Haven 12's lamps.

inn_takings.desc: A cloth bag of chits stamped with the Brine & Barrel's mark.

med_herbs.desc: Cactus pulp, creosote and something Maren called "hope root".

opened_parcel.desc: Cass's parcel, seal broken. Oskar will notice.

ketarad.desc: Irradiated dissociative from a Gantry cookhouse. The world slides away and pain goes quiet, but you move like you're underwater and it soaks you in radiation. Lasts 2½ minutes. Taking a second dose while the first is still working drops you into a K-hole.

jolt.desc: Crushed caffeine pills and something worse. Faster legs, faster hands, a heart like a drum. Crashes hard afterwards.

dustweed.desc: A hand-rolled smoke of desert weed. Slow healing, a smooth tongue (+2 Charm) and a mellow, golden afternoon.

glowshine.desc: Moonshine run through a reactor coolant line. +2 Might, heavy hands, a green world and a dose of radiation.

bonecrete.desc: Calcium paste and military stims. +35 damage resistance, heavy grey limbs.

brightsight.desc: Eye drops from a pre-war lab. Night turns to dusk and your aim sharpens.

stillwater.desc: A sniper's sedative. Your pulse slows, your rifle stops shaking, the world goes quiet.

clean_slate.desc: A brutal detox kit. Clears every chem addiction. You will not enjoy the next ten minutes.

bobby_pin.desc: Bent wire for picking locks. They break. Carry plenty.

reactor_logs.desc: A binder of operator logs from the last week before the war. The final pages are in a shaking hand.

deputy_badge.desc: A tin star, bent. DUSTWELL — DEPUTY. Somebody's blood has dried in the grooves.

harmonica.desc: A dented harmonica in a velvet sleeve. Engraved: FOR T., WHO HUMS.

dog_collar.desc: A collar made of a belt and a bottle cap. RUSTY, it says, in a child's letters.

scar_pelt.desc: The hide of the biggest Dust Stalker anyone has ever seen. Hollis will want to see this.

jack_tags.desc: The cattle tag Jack wore in his ear. Proof enough for any sheriff.

magnum.desc: A six-shooter with a barrel like a railroad spike. Every shot is a decision.

grease_gun.desc: Stamped steel and bad intentions. Slow-firing for an SMG, which is why it hits anything.

service_rifle.desc: Highway Patrol carried these on Route 9. The patrol is gone. The rifles are not.

bullpup.desc: Air-base security rifle. Short, quick, and the magazine sits behind your cheek.

marksman_carbine.desc: Semi-automatic and accurate. For people who want to be far away and right.

sawed_off.desc: Two barrels, two decisions, both of them final at three metres.

anti_materiel.desc: Plant security bought it to stop trucks. It stops trucks.

frag.desc: Military fragmentation grenade. Bigger, meaner and more reliable than a pipe bomb. Use to ready it, NADE to throw.

molotov.desc: Shatters on impact and sets the ground alight for eight seconds. Use to ready it, NADE to throw.

pulse_nade.desc: An electromagnetic burst. Wrecks robots and drones, barely tickles flesh. Use to ready it, NADE to throw.

holotape.desc: A cracked Route 9 patrol holotape. Old Marsh in Tin Row collects these.

toll_ledger.desc: Names, dates, "fees". Half of Tin Row is in here, marked PAID or MARKED.

rotgut.desc: Distilled from something. Do not ask what. +6 HP, +2 rads.

echo_shard.desc: A splinter of a sound you heard once and forgot. It hums when you hold it to your ear.

lattice_key.desc: It is not a key. It is the idea of a key. In the Hole, it keeps the door open longer and always brings you home.

hole_pebble.desc: A pebble from somewhere that is not anywhere. It is warm, and very slightly purple, and it remembers you.

old_hat.desc: A hat. Mister Pockets will know whose.

goose_locket.desc: Inside: a photo of a woman with very surprised eyebrows. "TO GOOSE, FROM EVERYONE".

k_fizz.desc: Dr. Kettle's "gentle" carbonated ketarad. It is not gentle. Two doses in a row will drop you through the floor of the world.

iron_gut.d: No radiation from food or water, +25% healing.

ghost.d: Harder to detect while sneaking. Sneak attacks hit harder.

locksmith.d: Pick any lock regardless of Agility, with a wider sweet spot.

agility: Move speed, reload speed, Action Points
charm: Better prices and new things to say

sheriff.t:
> ENTRY 211
Well ran green again. Boiled it twice. Still tastes like pennies.

> ENTRY 214
Kess and her yard dogs came by for "taxes". Took the purifier chip instead when we came up short. I counted nine guns. I have four deputies and one of them is my cousin.

> ENTRY 217
Hooded people on the west road again, carrying lanterns at noon. They asked how many of ours died of cold the winter before last. I told them eleven. They wrote it down.

> ENTRY 219
Halloran radioed from Bunker Nine. Says the Meridian plant is venting. Says somebody would have to go in and deal with it by hand. Nobody volunteered.

> ENTRY 220
Lights up on the south ridge tonight. Old shelter door, the one with the 12 on it. If anybody walks out of there, I intend to be polite.

bunker.t:
> SUBJECT: GROUNDWATER
Samples from the Dens and the Overpass show the same isotope. I need one from the Dustwell well and one from a pool to close the argument.

> SUBJECT: THE GLOW BRUTE
A maintenance crew sealed themselves in the core chamber when the alarms went. Chief Engineer Abbott is still in there. He is not a "he" any more. He was carrying the replacement coolant regulator. He still is.

> SUBJECT: THE SPARE CARD
I have one keycard in the desk. I have had it for two winters. I am a coward and I know it.

> SUBJECT: TREATMENT
Rad Flush works. Dirty water does not. Stop drinking from puddles, you absolute walnuts.

reactor.t:
WELCOME TO MERIDIAN ATOMICS!
"Clean power for a bright tomorrow."

DAYS SINCE LAST INCIDENT: 73,412
(counter error — please contact your supervisor)

> NOTICE TO ALL STAFF
Reactor No. 2 COLD START received via RELAY 4. Authorisation: CASTELLAN, R. (inherited credential).

> FAULT
Coolant regulator failure, loop B. Replacement unit signed out to: ABBOTT, Chief Eng. Not installed.

> NOTICE TO ALL STAFF
The core chamber is sealed. The control terminal inside can INSTALL a replacement regulator or perform a MANUAL SCRAM.

> NOTICE TO ALL STAFF
Do NOT feed whatever is living in Cooling Pond B.

overpass.t:
> AUTOMATED BROADCAST — LOOPING
...all northbound lanes are closed. Residents with a reserved place should proceed calmly to their assigned shelter. Residents without a reserved place should remain calm.

> OUTBOUND COMMAND LOG
03:12  TO: MERIDIAN No.2 VIA RELAY 4
       CMD: COLD START, FULL SEQUENCE
       AUTH: CASTELLAN, R.
       STATUS: ACCEPTED

> LAST USER MESSAGE
it worked. grandmother's codes still work. they'll have heat by morning.
if anyone reads this: we are the lamplighters. we're at the burned chapel, west of dustwell. come and see what a light looks like. — R.

there was a fusion cell here. wick will want it.

overseer.t:
> LOG 0447
Recycler coolant regulator: FAILED. Chief Engineer Pell confirms no repair possible.
Clean water reserve: 9 days at full ration. 14 days at half.

> LOG 0448
Pre-war supply records list Meridian Atomics Reactor No. 2 as the only installation in the valley using the R-7 regulator.
The Meridian plant is roughly 4.5 km north of the door.

> LOG 0449
I have chosen the courier. I will not record the name here. If this fails, I want the blame on me and not on them.

> LOG 0450
Door opening sequence authorised. May the sky be kind.

i9_sign.t:
> PATROL LOG — CAR 7
19:02  Sirens valley-wide. All units to northbound on-ramps.
19:20  Northbound jammed solid from the Dry Wash to the river.
19:41  Order from Haven Shelter Co.: "subscribers only past the bridge". We are to check papers.
19:58  People are leaving their cars and walking. We are not stopping them.
20:30  Flash in the south. Then the sound. Then the wind.
20:31  The span at the Dry Wash is gone. There were cars on it.

> LAST ENTRY
Car 7 out of fuel. Walking north with the Dacosta family. If found: we tried.

i9_kings.h: SCRAWLED ON A PILLAR // UNDER THE INTERSTATE
i9_kings.t:
THE ROAD IS OURS
THE TOLL IS FAIR
WATER - 2 JUGS
FOOD - 1 SACK
NO PAY = NO PASS
NO PASS = NO PERSON

(underneath, in different paint)
REMEMBER

tinrow.t:
> MAYOR'S NOTICE
Stills to be at least ten paces from any roof. This means you, Hector.

> FOR TRADE
Two goats, one opinionated. Ask for Wren.

> MISSING
Pip of Saltreach's dog RUSTY. Red, friendly, eats lizards. FOUND, thanks to the vault stranger.

> WARNING
Overpass Kings sighted on the west road with fire bottles. Travel in daylight. Travel armed. Travel fast.

haven_co.t:
HAVEN SHELTER COMPANY
"Tomorrow, Guaranteed."

> SUBSCRIPTION STATUS LOOKUP
Family: MARSH       Plan: SILVER (4 places)    Status: LAPSED — 2 payments
Family: DACOSTA     Plan: BRONZE (2 places)    Status: WAITLIST
Family: CASTELLAN   Plan: STAFF            Status: REVOKED (disciplinary)

> MEMO — DO NOT DISTRIBUTE
Haven 12 capacity is 400. Subscriptions sold: 1,150. In the event of activation, admission will be on a first-come basis, with priority given to Platinum and Staff plans. Security to be briefed.

meridian_memo.t:
FROM: Board Office
TO: All Site Managers
RE: Haven partnership

Meridian will supply Haven Shelters with long-life coolant regulators for their recyclers at cost. In exchange, Meridian senior staff receive Platinum placement.

Note: Engineering staff below Grade 6 are not included. Please do not discuss this with Engineering.

> REPLY — R. CASTELLAN, ENGINEERING GRADE 5
I built the regulators you're selling them. I'll remember this.

quarry_journal.h: A DIARY, PAGES STUCK WITH DUST
quarry_journal.t:
Day 1. Found the quarry. Walls on three sides, one way in. Safe.
Day 9. Something knocks on the stone at night. Three knocks, then quiet.
Day 14. It's not knocking. It's digging.
Day 15. Stinger the length of my arm. Took Pell's mule.
Day 16. We're leaving. If you read this, so should you.

drone_log.t:
> TASK QUEUE (AUTONOMOUS SALVAGE, KESTREL AIRFIELD)
- strip copper: vehicles, sector 4      ...COMPLETE
- strip copper: vehicles, sector 5      ...COMPLETE
- strip copper: human settlements       ...AUTHORISED (owner unreachable 71,204 days)
- return to depot                        ...DEPOT NOT FOUND
- repeat

ironside_order.t:
1. The fort will hold the western valley until relieved.
2. Relief is expected within 72 hours.
3. Rations to be halved after day 30.
4. Rations to be halved again after day 300.
5. Day 2,000. Relief is still expected. The order stands. — Capt. M. Ironside (acting)

kettle_board.h: KETTLE HOLLOW // HOUSE RULES (PAINTED ON A DOOR)
kettle_board.t:
1. ONE DOSE IS A HOLIDAY
2. TWO DOSES IS A JOURNEY
3. THREE DOSES IS NOT ALLOWED (WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT THREE IS)
4. IF YOU COME BACK SOMEWHERE ELSE, WALK HOME. WE WILL KEEP YOUR CHAIR.
5. DO NOT FEED GRAVY DAVE GRAVY. IT ENCOURAGES HIM.
6. THE TELEVISION IS NOT ON. IT HAS NEVER BEEN ON. STOP ASKING IT QUESTIONS.
7. BE KIND TO PEOPLE WHO ARE "DEAD". IT IS A HARD TIME FOR THEM.

hole_glyphs.h: THE LATTICE // A STONE COVERED IN GLYPHS
hole_glyphs.t:
OLLOM . VESH . KRR . TIKKA . VOON
(you understand it the way you understand a dream: all at once, and wrong)

"Everyone who falls through the floor lands here.
 Everyone who lands here leaves.
 Leaving is the only rule.
 The second rule is: mind the furniture."
